name: drugex-book
description: DrugEx: De Novo Drug Design & 3D Shape-Matching — Publication Monograph (Nature Style)

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:continuation
scripts.test: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" typst compile book/main.typ DrugEx_Book_Master.pdf && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" typst compile book/continuation.typ DrugEx_Book_Advanced_Continuation.pdf && test -s DrugEx_Book_Master.pdf && test -s DrugEx_Book_Advanced_Continuation.pdf

author: David Kolar (VŠCHT Praha / ÚOCHB AV ČR)
